semiconductor_relevance: High — OEG GmbH specializes in high-precision optical measuring systems specifically designed for the semiconductor industry.
summary: OEG GmbH develops and produces advanced optical measuring instruments, including fully automatic contact angle measuring devices tailored for semiconductor applications. Their products, such as the SURFTENS WH 300, are designed for use in highly automated wafer fabs, providing critical measurement capabilities for semiconductor manufacturing.
